description: Defines the ThemeModel class in the OrangeHRM project, representing a theme configuration for corporate branding. It implements serialization and normalization functionality, including properties for theme attributes and methods for converting theme entities to array representations.

classes.name: ThemeModel
classes.description: Represents a theme configuration for corporate branding, implements serialization, normalizable, and converts a PartialTheme entity to an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ThemeModel with a PartialTheme entity and sets up filtering and attribute naming.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the ThemeModel entity to an array, including optional banner and logo filenames.
